LESSON: CLEANING NOSE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Myself
Topic 1.3: Cleaning Nose
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning Nose, part of Myself in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we clean our nose? 2. Why do we clean our nose?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning Nose together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving: learner improvises handkerchief using suitable materials.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner enhances self- drive when using a clean handkerchief.

• Respect: learner enhances etiquette when cleaning nose.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Personal hygiene: as they clean their nose.

Link to other learning area:

Items used to clean the nose relates to new words learnt in Language in Mathematical Activities.

Suggested learning Resources

A theme-based multi-purpose Communication Board on cleaning nose, adapted digital devices with special accessibility features

and software, head/ mouth pointers, A clean handkerchief, videos clips on cleaning the nose, adapted cutting tools such as

scissors with padded handles, an old garment fabric, audio-visual recorder

Other Related Service Providers: Physiotherapist, Learner support Assistant/ Scribe
